integrity: Reproducible finite proof by enumeration of all relevant subsets, integral oriented-boundary unit minor and oriented incidence; code and actual execution output embedded.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite instance only: the five-regular Clebsch graph and ordinary four-cut parameter. Dual homotopy type is established, but no original-complex homotopy type, persistence map, higher-dimensional folded-cube family, group character, or independent validation is claimed.
title: The ordinary four-cut complex of the folded five-cube has two free homology degrees
